headline: A quiet day with no new events
body: No new events were scored. All endings moved by less than 0.1 point as earlier news faded; Gatekeeper slipped about 0.02 as the boost from recent rule-making wore off. The world factors held steady after a busy week, and Horizon Balance was almost unchanged at -2.04.
movers_note: No ending moved by 0.1 or more; Gatekeeper's -0.02 was the largest drift, from fading earlier news.
